item.text:
Completed the pricing-decision migration and subscription version changes.

The migration selects the price effective at approval, falls back to the legacy fee when needed, and removes the legacy field after creating decisions. It rejects negative historical fees with SQLSTATE `P0001` and rolls back without changing the old data. New subscription versions no longer carry forward the old fee decision.

Validation passed: `bun test` and PostgreSQL 18 checks covering successful migration and rollback on a negative fee.
